source.note: by hand, 2026-11-04, after rove2-C-hold140-shooter100 (the firing Rover in the band was hit the moment the extractor passed 65 %, the holding one behind it never): the Rover holds fire 115 behind the extractor while a Rocko 424 from it and 671 from the turret (outside its reach) rockets the extractor past 65 %. If the held Rover is hit then, the extractor's state changes with its damage; if not, the firing unit's own state opens the turret's line.
